name: IconCloud
description: Icons laid out on a slowly turning sphere, built with CSS 3D transforms and no canvas. Each icon can be a link, a button or a plain image, and the list keeps one fixed order for the keyboard.

items.tsType: Array<{ id?: string; label: string; icon: import("react").ReactNode; href?: string; onPress?: () => void }>
items.description: The icons. label is the accessible name. An item with href is a link, one with onPress is a button, and any other is a plain icon.

size.description: Width and height of the sphere in pixels.

iconSize.description: Width and height of each icon in pixels.

label.description: Accessible name of the list of icons.

isPaused.description: Stops the turning. Moving content that lasts more than five seconds should be stoppable.

keyboard: Tab: moves to each link or button in the order of the items array
Enter: follows a link or presses a button; Space presses a button
requirements: The icons are real list items in a fixed DOM order that never follows the rotation, so keyboard order is stable
Each link and button has an accessible name from label; plain icons are images with that label
The turning pauses while the pointer is over the cloud or focus is inside it, and with isPaused or the rdm-still class (WCAG 2.2.2)
Visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion) get a still sphere
Icons are kept facing the viewer while the sphere turns, so they are never mirrored or edge-on
Focus shows a visible ring on the icon in every colour mode
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
screenReader: Announced as a list with the given label; each link, button or image is read in order with its label

use_when: Showing the range of tools or technologies a product supports
A decorative hero graphic whose icons may also link somewhere
avoid_when: Navigation, because moving targets are hard to use
Icons that need a visible text caption
anti_patterns: Icons that are only recognisable by colour
Dozens of items, which crowd the sphere and overlap
